GRIEVANCE IX ◆ INSTITUTIONAL INDEPENDENCE

He has weakened the civil service’s insulation from personal and political command.

THE RECORD SHOWS

The administration created Schedule Policy/Career to make designated career policy-influencing posts easier to remove, changing long-standing employment protections.

OPM finalized the new personnel category in February 2026 and issued implementation guidance. The agency characterizes the reform as strengthening performance and accountability while retaining merit principles. Critics warn that removal of ordinary adverse-action protections can make expert public servants dependent on political favor. The documented action is the rule change; a universal purge of every career employee is not established by that rule alone.

A DOCUMENTED SEQUENCE

3 MILESTONES
  1. January 20, 2025Trump ordered reclassification of certain career policy-influencing employees.
  2. February 5, 2026OPM finalized the Schedule Policy/Career regulations.
  3. February–June 2026OPM issued guidance to agencies implementing the new classification.
